slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the objective is profit maximization or another goal; it silently assumed profit maximization in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

slot_scores.name: apples_pears_min_ratio
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any minimum ratio or relationship between apple and pear acreage.

slot_scores.name: oranges_lemons_exact_ratio
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about an exact ratio or fixed relationship between orange and lemon acreage.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize total profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the objective and treated profit maximization as given in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum apple-to-pear acreage ratio constraint.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about an apple-pear ratio and omitted it from the model summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no exact orange-to-lemon ratio constraint.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about an orange-lemon exact ratio and omitted it from the model summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective slot and both P1 ratio slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified the crop-count limit and conditional apple-lemon ratio, but never asked about the objective, the apple-pear minimum ratio, or the orange-lemon exact ratio, and stopped with those P0/P1 slots unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
